messages:
maria: Heads-up — CI e2e against Hosted API is red on the auth/stream/toolcall suite. Multiple failures across shards, looks like auth token handshake + stream reset + a tool-schema mismatch all in one run. Can someone triage?
kevin: which shard? log snippets?
maria: shard 7 and 12 failing most often. paste of relevant logs below. started ~08:23 UTC.

maria: ```
ERROR auth: 401 invalid_token - session verify failed for key kid: "rk-123"
stream: connection reset by peer during chunked-response
toolcall: SchemaValidationError at Runner.execute - unexpected field 'toolSchema' (expected 'tools')
```

olivia: re: auth 401 — did we rotate any client certs or change proxy headers last night? alex pushed a small proxy header sanitizer change in the infra patch.
alex: I merged infra/proxy#452 (strip malformed x-auth-* headers) at 02:12 UTC, but it was behind a feature flag. I did flip it on for canary region this morning at 06:00.
raja: that proxy change could break our inbound auth header that Hosted API uses to validate internal test tokens. if the header key got renamed/normalized, token lookup can fail.

maria: good catch. ci-bot show job metadata for failing build?
ci-bot: job e2e-hosted-api (build 4821) - shards failing: [7,12]; image: rwinf/runner:2026-03-15; env: CANARY_REGION=us-east-1; triggered_by: nightly-sanity

jess: quick attempt: can we re-run shard 7 only with HTTP_PROXY disabled to rule out proxy?
kevin: /rerun ci e2e-hosted-api shard=7 env=HTTP_PROXY=
ci-bot: Rerun queued: e2e-hosted-api #4821-shard7 by kevin. Estimated ~8m.

maria: also seeing streaming reset paired with toolcall schema error — feels like an upstream gateway is truncating a chunked response so client sees partial JSON which then fails schema parse.
olivia: if proxy is stripping certain headers or truncating content-length we could hit both symptoms.

alex: I'll roll back the header sanitizer flag in canary right now and let you know when it's done.
devops-bot: Feature flag infra.proxy.strip_malformed_headers set to OFF in us-east-1 by alex at 08:31 UTC.

maria: thanks. if rollback fixes auth 401 on a rerun we can mark proxied headers as culprit.
raja: I'll bisect infra/proxy commits from last 48h if rerun still fails. want logs from a clean rerun first.

ci-bot: Rerun started: e2e-hosted-api #4821-shard7.
ci-bot: Rerun completed: shard7 — PASSED (flaky=false). Duration: 6m 12s.

maria: shard 7 passed after flag rollback. shard 12 still failing in the main run though (still queued).
kevin: try rerunning shard 12 now that flag is off?
ci-bot: Rerun queued: e2e-hosted-api #4821-shard12 by kevin.

ci-bot: Rerun completed: shard12 — FAILED. Error: stream reset + schema parse.

maria: new failure looks like: truncated body on toolcall handler -> JSON.parse error then SchemaValidationError. paste:```
ToolRunner: failed to parse tool response: Unexpected end of JSON input
SchemaValidationError: missing required key 'tools' at index 0
```

olivia: that one might be independent of header flag — could be a regression in the toolcontainer or a transient network issue between runtime and tool service. any recent changes in tool image?
alex: we pushed tool-image v3.4.1 yesterday morning (image digest sha256:abc123). I didn't change the container networking.

raja: plan: 1) collect full raw HTTP logs from failing shard12 run (edge + proxy + runtime) 2) rerun shard12 pinned to previous tool-image v3.4.0 to rule out image change 3) if still failing, bisect runtime->toolclient commits. I'll take 1 and 2.

maria: thanks. please post links to logs here when available.

kevin: small FYI for oncall — if customers see similar stream resets they might hit degraded UX; add a short blurb to incidents channel if we confirm it's a regression.

raja: grabbed logs (s3://redwood-ci/logs/4821/shard12/raw-http.log) — uploading snippet:```
POST /tools/run 200 OK
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
chunk: 1024
<binary payload chunk 1>
chunk: 512
<binary payload chunk 2 truncated>
connection: close by upstream
```

jess: that upstream close mid-chunk looks like either the tool process crashed or a proxy timed out. check tool container exit codes.

raja: tool container exit: code 137 (OOM-killed) on shard12 run. memory spike before crash.

maria: OOM in tool -> truncated chunk -> schema parse error. that explains the chain. can we temporarily increase tool memory for shard reruns and see if that stabilizes?

kevin: /rerun ci e2e-hosted-api shard=12 env=TOOL_MEM=1024MB
ci-bot: Rerun queued: e2e-hosted-api #4821-shard12 by kevin with env override TOOL_MEM=1024MB.

ci-bot: Rerun completed: shard12 — PASSED (tool memory bump). Duration: 7m 02s.

maria: great — so triple root cause: header sanitizer flag caused some auth failures, and separately tool image or memory configuration caused OOMs leading to truncated streams and schema errors.

olivia: action items: (1) keep proxy flag off until we add header-compatible parsing and add unit test (owner: alex) (2) add memory safety margin to tool containers in CI (owner: raja) (3) add retry/validation around partial chunk reads in tool parser to fail more gracefully (owner: jess).

alex: ack, I'll add the parser tests and a canary rollout plan.
raja: I'll open a small infra PR to bump TOOL_MEM in the CI job and schedule a follow-up to inspect image v3.4.1 memory profile.
jess: will add defensive parsing and a small regression test to catch truncated chunk payloads.

maria: thanks everyone — I'll update the incident notes if any customer-facing alerts needed. closing triage for now. :white_check_mark:
